display_name: 三专家源波形蒸馏单专家 GPU 训练
description: 冻结 DURA，独立初始化单多尺度修正；用合法源 IQ 和固定三专家源波形教师训练，推理不调用三专家。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off; source prepare batch 32, train batch 32, ground/scoring CPU 2 threads

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0 and fixed source-only three-expert waveform teacher; fresh independently initialized single multiscale correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Expert teacher source ancestry, no target/F/TX/V, deterministic context and exact ordered 32768 fit IDs and three views checked before training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA and expert teacher source-only with matching data contract and no target ancestry; student independently initialized
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, at most one this-run worker and at most 3 total compute workers including others; check capacity; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: Single multiscale DURA correction with IQ guard plus 0.5 normalized source-only expert-mixture waveform teacher loss
rows.purpose: Distill frozen source-only mixture into single DURA correction at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: Correction seed 2026110612, source fit seed 2026110611, order seed 2026110613; fixed DURA seed 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: Frozen DURA 266951 parameters plus fresh single correction 117062, total 384013; 32768 IDs x 3 fixed views, five epochs batch32; teacher and context caches reused, source teacher and mixture training costs additional

notes: Source-only original DURA context and fixed source-only three-expert IQ teacher are used during training; no F weights or outputs, TX labels, V or target.
Student IQ loss and DURA guard plus 0.5 normalized student-versus-mixture waveform loss, fresh zero-head initialization and final fixed epoch 5.
Teacher cache 98304 source views matches exact ordered fit IDs, epochs21/22/23 and same deterministic source context; source pilot and target excluded from fitting.
Inference uses DURA and single 117062-parameter correction; three-expert network and teacher cache are absent. Actual latency and ground performance remain unmeasured.
Freeze final epoch independent of source or target scores; complete all seven 168000-record Phase1 views, fixed Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, independent truth-last scoring.
Parent mixture has 351301 trainable parameters and three correction forwards; teacher generation and parent training costs counted separately.
